mapper.select: SELECT t_price_bidding.tender_number AS tenderNumber, t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_price_bidding.quantity AS quantity, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime, COUNT(t_price_bidding.latest_quotation) AS biddingFrequency, t_sales_bidding.low_price AS initialQuotation FROM t_price_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_price_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} GROUP BY t_price_bidding.tender_number, t_price_bidding.customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation, t_price_bidding.quantity, t_price_bidding.quotation_time, t_sales_bidding.low_price ORDER BY t_price_bidding.quotation_time DESC

SELECT t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} ORDER BY t_price_bidding.quotation_time ASC

SELECT t_price_bidding.customer AS customer, t_price_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_price_bidding.quotation_time AS quotationTime FROM t_price_bidding WHERE t_price_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_price_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} AND t_price_bidding.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY t_price_bidding.quotation_time ASC
select company_name from t_price_bidding where tender_number = #{tenderNumber} group by company_name
